content.text: I added "Work late with your $70/$100. (6h)" to `act_work_shift` in `toml_phases/3_activities.toml`. It opens a new `late` screen that adds two hours: same day pay, 10 more energy spent, and +1 `office_talk`; it doesn't set `stayed_late`, so Callahan's review line ("I asked you to stay late") stays true. I also logged it in `v2_state.json`; the TOML and JSON both parse, but I didn't merge, build or run the gates, so nothing has been checked in play.

import json
p='v2_state.json'

d['decisions'].append({
 "date": "2026-10-02",
 "by": "LO",
 "what": "act_work_shift gets 'Work late'",
 "detail": "Two choices on act_work_shift.shift (review_passed false/true) route to the new node act_work_shift.late: 6h total, the same day rate ($70 / $100), energy -40 instead of -30, office_talk +1. It does not set stayed_late, because callahan_review.work reads that flag as Callahan having asked her to stay. The latest start is 13:00, so 13:00 + 6h = 19:00, the firm's earliest close.",
 "replaces_heat": "nothing removed; no explicit beat added"
})
json.dump(d,open(p,'w'),indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)
open(p,'a').write('\n')

result: I added "Work late with your $70/$100. (6h)" to `act_work_shift` in `toml_phases/3_activities.toml`. It opens a new `late` screen that adds two hours: same day pay, 10 more energy spent, and +1 `office_talk`; it doesn't set `stayed_late`, so Callahan's review line ("I asked you to stay late") stays true. I also logged it in `v2_state.json`; the TOML and JSON both parse, but I didn't merge, build or run the gates, so nothing has been checked in play.
